# Tool releases

The external tools this platform runs: one `folio-tool-release/v1` file per tool at one version, with the sha256 of its bytes, where to fetch it, its SPDX licence, how to run it and the runtimes that release needs; and one `folio-tool-profile/v1` file per named set of releases a run selects. A profile never names a runtime.

Part of [C@T Harness](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `tool-releases`, holding `tool-release`.
